title: Pasting Local Longitudinal IV Bounds for Terminal Welfare in Two-Stage Binary Models
banked_reason: D0.5.G achieved subfield below the immutable field floor: the exact-projection binary specialization is sound, but its paper-score ceiling is 6.5 < 7.4.
gap_reasons: The sharp equality criterion, optimized gap formula, attained quarter bound, and policy-reversal witness are proved only for binary outcomes, one-sided first-stage delivery, exact second-stage compliance, exact local projections, and terminal welfare; arbitrary-reward results are chiefly exposed-face geometry; paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4, so field is capped at subfield.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved an observed-cell equality criterion, a closed-form optimized Bellman/global welfare gap, a sharp attained 1/4 upper bound, and a legal interior policy-reversal witness using response-type fiber surgery. The field-level promise collapsed because these results remain confined to a binary, one-sided-first-stage, exact-second-stage, exact-projection, terminal-welfare specialization; extending the theory to broader compliance, outcomes, or outer local sets is a new substantive project rather than a bounded repair.
tldr: Can exact local longitudinal-IV continuation bounds be pasted safely for terminal welfare? In the complete two-stage binary model, every treated policy has exact loss \(n\max_x\lambda_x(d)\), one branchwise rule maximizes both treated criteria, and the optimized gap is \(\Delta(Y)=\min\{(T-S)_+,\delta\}\leq 1/4\), with the constant \(1/4\) attained and sharp over all feasible faces. Equality holds exactly when \(n=0\) or \(S\geq T\), while a separate interior six-atom construction gives a legal \(1/2\) versus \(2/5\) first-action reversal. The generic cone geometry is supporting only, and the Chen--Zhang comparison is restricted to their all-worst-case recursion with exact local projections.
gap: One joint longitudinal response law uses the observed never-taker stratum only once, whereas exact historywise projections can allocate that same stratum separately to both counterfactual \(X(1)\) branches. Existing causal recursions and robust-MDP rectangularity results do not give an observed-cell equality criterion for this IV coupling.
fill: Prove the cell formulas sharply from the 128-type fiber and all 32 observation equations, derive the optimized equality theorem, establish the source-faithful Chen--Zhang correspondence, and present the rational primal-dual policy-reversal witness as a specialization.
